verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a national tax authority can document how a non-resident registers. But no evidence item mentions non-residents, foreign founders, eligibility from abroad, or acceptable foreign identifiers. The agent sign-up option and the general online registration rails are adjacent features, not a documented non-resident path.

support.subject: As a foreign founder, the service documents a path for a non-resident to complete this task — eligibility, acceptable foreign credentials or identifiers, and any extra steps stated on its own pages
